findings.message: schema: section "Body" declares an item-key, and its content is not bullet-list or numbered-list
schema: section "Items" declares item-key `^`P_[a-z-]+`` with no capture group — the key is the one capture, so the rule binds nothing
section "Behaviour" item `- `P_Stops` [event] WHEN told, the thing SHALL stop — the key is malformed.` carries no key, and thing.md declares item-key `^`(P_[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*)``
section "Behaviour" item `- [state] WHILE running, the thing SHALL answer — no key at all.` carries no key, and thing.md declares item-key `^`(P_[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*)``

section "Stability" item `- `P_starts` [ubiquitous] The thing SHALL keep its start — a repeated key.` repeats key `P_starts`, carried by section "Behaviour" item `- `P_starts` [event] WHEN asked, the thing SHALL start.`, and thing.md declares item-key
